# cloudxino_container_host (Data Source)

A Managed Container Service host of the team, by `name` or `id` (for hosts made outside this configuration).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A container host made in the console, by name.
data "cloudxino_container_host" "apps" {
  name = "apps"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `compose` (String) The saved `docker-compose.yml`; null before the first.
- `domains` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `env_keys` (List of String) Names of the saved environment variables (not their values).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IPv4 address; point domains' A records here.
- `last_deployment` (Attributes) The newest deployment; null before the first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_deployment))
- `plan` (String) Plan slug (a CC2 size).
- `portainer_url` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `status` (String) `creating`, `installing`, `ready`, `failed`, `deleting` or `deleted`.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `service` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--last_deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `last_deployment`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`.
